dashboard.label: TA-amdgpu Metrics
dashboard.description: Index-time metrics over index=metrics (sourcetype amdgpu:metrics); series prefixed 'amdgpu.'.

panel.title: Commercial use of TA-amdgpu requires a paid license (evaluation, personal, lab use free)

search.query: | makeresults | eval buy="Buy License at bentleypc.com/TA-amdgpu", terms="License and Terms at bentleypc.com/TA-amdgpu/LICENSE.html" | fields buy terms

panel.title: License status (click a row to configure the key)

search.query: index=main sourcetype="ta_license:status" latest=now earliest=-48h | stats latest(_time) as seen, latest(status) as status, latest(message) as note by host | eval last_reported=strftime(seen,"%F %H:%M") | table host status last_reported note
| mstats avg("amdgpu.*") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "amdgpu.*"
| mstats avg("amdgpu.*busy_pct") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "amdgpu.*busy_pct"
| mstats avg("amdgpu.*temperature_c") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "amdgpu.*temperature_c"
| mstats avg("amdgpu.*vram_used_mib") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "amdgpu.*vram_used_mib"
| mstats avg("amdgpu.*vram_total_mib") as "v*" where index=metrics by metric_name span=5m | rename v* as "amdgpu.*vram_total_mib"
